name: rchilli-mcp-hub
description: RChilli HR Intelligence MCP — parse resumes and job descriptions, match candidates, enrich skills with ONet/ESCO taxonomy, redact bias fields, and convert documents through any MCP-enabled AI assistant.

tools.name: parse_resume
tools.description: Extracts 200+ normalized fields from resume text

tools.name: parse_resume_from_url
tools.description: Parses a resume from a public URL

tools.name: parse_job_description
tools.description: Parses a job description into structured role data

tools.name: lookup_skill
tools.description: Returns authoritative detail for any skill from ONet/ESCO taxonomy

tools.name: lookup_job_profile
tools.description: Returns canonical detail for any job profile or title

tools.name: autocomplete_skill
tools.description: Returns skill name suggestions for a partial keyword

tools.name: autocomplete_job_profile
tools.description: Returns job profile suggestions for a partial keyword

tools.name: redact_resume
tools.description: Removes bias and PII fields from a resume

tools.name: reformat_resume_with_template
tools.description: Restyles a resume into a branded template

tools.name: convert_document_format
tools.description: Converts a resume document between formats

tools.name: extract_named_entities
tools.description: Tags named entities from any HR text

tools.name: extract_contact_info
tools.description: Extracts contact details from unstructured text

tools.name: geocode_locations
tools.description: Resolves latitude and longitude for locations

tools.name: determine_job_zone
tools.description: Determines O*NET Job Zone level for a resume or JD

tools.name: score_resume_against_jd
tools.description: Produces an explainable fit score between a resume and a JD

tools.name: find_matches_in_index
tools.description: Ranks an indexed talent pool against a source document

tools.name: search_indexed_documents
tools.description: Keyword search across indexed resumes or JDs

tools.name: index_document
tools.description: Index any resume or job description into RChilli's Search & Match engine so it can be searched, matched, updated, and reused across downstream recruitment workflows.

tools.name: analyze_hr_call
tools.description: Analyze recruiting calls for insights, sentiment, and action items.

tools.name: match_end_to_end
tools.description: Run complete candidate and job matching workflows.

tools.name: map_job_to_skills
tools.description: Map job descriptions to required and preferred skill taxonomies.

tools.name: generate_jd
tools.description: Create job descriptions from role inputs.

tools.name: generate_interview_questions
tools.description: Generate interview questions from job and candidate data.

tools.name: analyze_skill_gap
tools.description: Identify gaps between a profile and a target role.

tools.name: recommend_learning_path
tools.description: Recommend learning paths based on skill gaps.

tools.name: detect_bias
tools.description: Detect biased hiring language in Job Descriptions and screening criteria.

tools.name: normalize_candidate_data
tools.description: Standardize candidate data across multiple ATS systems.

tools.name: screen_application_batch
tools.description: Screen a batch of candidates and recommend next actions.

tools.name: detect_resume_suspicion
tools.description: Flag suspicious claims or inconsistencies in candidate profiles.

tools.name: normalize_hr_data_with_lov
tools.description: Map raw HR data values — degrees, universities, certifications, job profiles, skills, and locations — to standardized List of Values (LoV) entries based on your configured LoV categories.

tools.name: skill_mapping
tools.description: Extract, cluster, normalize, and infer a candidate's full skill profile from resume text — returning a structured, taxonomy-mapped skill set with explanatory notes in a recruiter-ready HTML output.

tools.name: analyze_skill_adjacency
tools.description: Query RChilli's skill adjacency graph to find related skills, identify candidate skill gaps, check near-fit candidates against a role, and recommend learning paths — all from a single talent intelligence engine.
